text:
arya: FYI seeing a bump in structured-output schema rejects on canary (eu-west) starting ~09:11 UTC, lots of fncall/tool-invoke paths.
devin: ugh, is it full rejects or soft-validate?
arya: full rejects. upstream adapter returned an array instead of object twice, validator_score 0.12 both times.
mike: is the console showing the raw payload? we should add breadcrumbs if we don't have them.
linda: console currently shows a truncated sample and the validator tag, but not the adapter version or parse path. that makes triage slow.
arya: proposal: emit a compact breadcrumb for each validation outcome with fields: validator_score, schema_version, adapter_sha, parse_path_hint, replay_id. tiny envelope ~120 bytes.
devin: love it. also need to decide billing semantics: should a schema reject count against token quota / billable calls? product asked yesterday and we have no consistent answer.
mike: product flagged customers complaining when their prompts are rejected then billed. maybe bill only for token decode work (not for the whole response)?
linda: technically we already bill on request receipt + output tokens. we could expose a toggle per-customer: bill_on_reject=true/false, default true for Hosted. but that adds billing complexity.
ops-bot: incident created: INC-4321 for canary surge, assigned to @mike and @arya :spiral_calendar: 
arya: immediate priorities: 1) add breadcrumb telemetry to canary agents 2) add a filter in console to show replay_id + raw adapter payload (expandable) 3) short-term: mark these rejects as "non-chargeable" in the trial tenant so support can avoid refunds.
devin: on the breadcrumb format, can we keep it backwards-compatible? many downstream consumers expect validator tags as strings. propose schema: {"v":"1","s":0.12,"sv":"2026-03-01","a":"adf3c" ,"p":"call.items.2" ,"r":"rid-..."} as a compact JSON string in the event blob.
mike: +1 compactness matters for our metrics pipeline. but console should decode pretty.
linda: console UX ask: add a toggle in the request inspector "Show validation breadcrumbs" that decodes the compact blob and highlights differences between expected shape and actual. minimal UI — show path, expected vs actual (one-line).
arya: rollout plan: wire the breadcrumb emission behind a feature flag for 24h, sample 100% on canary, 10% on prod for first 48h.
devin: sampling and retention: we should not store the full raw adapter payload for >7d by default. keep raw for 24h for triage then drop unless flagged. breadcrumbs kept 30d.
mike: telemetry question: add a "reject_reason" tag for metric aggregation and an approximate cost bucket (cheap/medium/expensive) so we can correlate cost spikes with reject patterns.
linda: also add a dashboard tile: "schema rejects / minute" with breakdown by adapter_sha and schema_version, and a table of top parse_path_hint.
arya: small implementation note — for streaming fncall cases we need to emit breadcrumb even if the fncall arrives mid-stream. attach replay_id early in the stream so we can join events.
devin: edge case: async adapters that return partial-success (status: accepted + items:[null,...]) — should we treat as soft-fail and surface as warning?
mike: propose three outcomes: PASS, SOFT_FAIL (returns best-effort with adapter payload attached), HARD_REJECT (block). console should surface SOFT_FAIL with a blue warning and allow replay.
arya: agrees. telemetry should tag SOFT_FAIL separately so billing can be handled differently.
linda: tiny code snippet for breadcrumb decoder we can add to console team docs:
```
// decompress compact breadcrumb
let b = JSON.parse(event.breadcrumb_blob);
console.log(`validator=${b.s} schema=${b.sv} path=${b.p} adapter=${b.a} replay=${b.r}`);
```
devin: can we also add an API flag in /v1/invoke like "validation.mode": "strict|soft|permissive" so SDKs can opt into behavior?
mike: API change is backwards-incompatible; we'll add it as optional header X-Validation-Mode for now. SDKs can adopt later.
arya: next steps: I'll open a PR that adds breadcrumb emission + replay_id to canary agent (link in thread when ready). mike/linda can sketch console cards and a dashboard query. devin plumb the billing toggle for trials.
ops-bot: @mike assigned to INC-4321. Status: investigating.
linda: thanks — aim to land canary flag today and sample prod tomorrow.
arya: thanks all, will post the PR link and a short playbook for support (how to mark requests non-chargeable) once ready.
mike: cheers, ping me on DM when PR is up and I'll smoke test the console decode.
